note: USACE Lake Red Rock campground, shaded. Swim beach about 1/4 mile from the camp. --Claude
summary: rec.gov confirms 50A, flush toilets, showers, water, dump, reservation required. Count 52 -> 43 public RV sites, fcfs never, 14-night limit and military discount added; $20-24 confirmed. Season unstated, USACE page refused. Not waterfront holds. Phone flag.
flags: WATERFRONT holds at not waterfront: every site is inside the wooded block, ringed by a road on the lake side; imagery shows no water in reach. Nearest water is about 200 m southwest of the nearest site, past the road and bare ground. Rec.gov's 'Hardwood forests cover the lake shore... scenic views' speaks to the area; no site carries a water tag.
PHONE: entry has none; rec.gov gives 641-828-7522 (facility, general) and 641-628-1701 (fee booth, local information). apply.py doesn't write phone.

RATE: the rate table carries two types for the same electric sites, $20 'STANDARD ELECTRIC' and $24 'Standard Electric 50 Amp', and every electric site is 50-amp in the catalog, so the true rate may be $24 throughout. Range kept; I couldn't see which a given site charges. Still under the gate.

SEASON: no statement read. Rate season 2026 is Apr 23-Oct 4, which is not a campground season; the USACE Rock Island district page answered 403 (Akamai denial) and I didn't try another route, so year_round stays as stored.
BOOKING: notice says 'North Overlook does not have a reservation window'; the inherited 180-day window stays, not verified. Same notice means a reservation first even when arriving at an empty site.
Pin ~110 m east of the 43 sites' centre (41.37916,-92.97031, mean of rec.gov coords): no move needed.
